title: Synthetic factory replay

qualification.scope: Known one-minute shift, gaps, bad quality and counter resets; stored-sample replay, not live PLC qualification

limitations: Synthetic only; no vendor, physical device or operator acceptance.
Node identities and cycle standard must be commissioned for each real machine.

title: Owned legacy gateway fixture

qualification.scope: Legacy gateway example mapping; test uses owned Modbus simulator

limitations: Not a vendor register map. Check offsets, endian order and scale with the responsible engineer.

title: Synthetic Boolean running state

qualification.scope: Owned stored-sample replay of true, false, a stale interval and BadNoCommunication through the spool and shift calculation; not live OPC UA transport or PLC qualification

limitations: A single Boolean only distinguishes running (true/1) from idle (false/0); fault and planned time are never inferred from it.
No counters are mapped, so quantities and OEE stay unknown until counter signals are added.
Synthetic only; node identities must be commissioned for each real machine.

title: Synthetic 16-bit counter rollover

equipment.model: Synthetic four-signal replay with UInt16 counters

qualification.scope: Owned stored-sample replay crossing 65530 to 4 with modulus 65536, plus a bad-quality boundary variant; not live OPC UA transport or PLC qualification

limitations: The modulus 65536 is an explicit equipment-specific choice; it is never inferred from a decreasing counter.
Confirm the counter width and wrap behavior with the responsible engineer before using rollover on a real machine.
Synthetic only; no vendor, physical device or operator acceptance.
